mapper.select: SELECT node_id as id, node_code as nodeCode, node_name as name, node_type as nodeType, node_level as nodeLevel, xcoordinate as xcoordinate, ycoordinate as ycoordinate, zcoordinate as zcoordinate, xrotation_angle as xrotationAngle, yrotation_angle as yrotationAngle, zrotation_angle as zrotationAngle, model_fileurl as modelFileurl, model_type as modelType, IF(STRCMP(node_type,"Leaf") = 0 OR STRCMP(node_type,"Root-Leaf") = 0, true , false ) as leaf, update_time as updateTime, memo as memo FROM m3_model_base_tree WHERE mb_id = #{mbId} AND node_level = 1 ORDER BY node_sort asc

SELECT node_id as id, node_code as nodeCode, node_name as name, node_type as nodeType, node_level as nodeLevel, xcoordinate as xcoordinate, ycoordinate as ycoordinate, zcoordinate as zcoordinate, xrotation_angle as xrotationAngle, yrotation_angle as yrotationAngle, zrotation_angle as zrotationAngle, model_fileurl as modelFileurl, url_img AS urlImg, model_size AS modelSize, model_type as modelType, IF(STRCMP(node_type,"Leaf") = 0 OR STRCMP(node_type,"Root-Leaf") = 0, true , false ) as leaf, update_time as updateTime, memo as memo FROM m3_model_base_tree WHERE node_code REGEXP CONCAT('^',#{nodeCode},'-[0-9]*$') ORDER BY node_sort asc

SELECT node_id as id, node_code as nodeCode, node_name as name, node_type as nodeType, IF (node_type = "Leaf" OR node_type = "Root-Leaf", true, false) as leaf, model_fileurl as modelFileurl, url_img AS urlImg, model_size AS modelSize, model_type AS modelType, xcoordinate as xcoordinate, ycoordinate as ycoordinate, zcoordinate as zcoordinate, xrotation_angle as xrotationAngle, yrotation_angle as yrotationAngle, zrotation_angle as zrotationAngle FROM m3_model_base_tree WHERE node_level = 1 ORDER BY node_sort ASC
